name: AWS CloudFront
description: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that allows easy way for companies to distribute content to end-users with low latency and high data transfer speeds. The Sumo Logic Application for CloudFront provides analytics on visitor information, rates and statistics, content being served, and other metrics.

panels.name: A lower time indicates faster performance in the panels below.
90th 95th 99th Pct Time_taken Trend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| timeslice 5m
| fillmissing timeslice(5m)
| pct(time_taken, 90, 95, 99) by _timeslice

panels.name: Outlier - Average Latency Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| timeslice 5m
| fillmissing timeslice(5m)
| avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by _timeslice
| outlier avg_time_taken threshold=5, window=12, direction=+

panels.name: Longest Latency by GeoLocation
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = c_ip
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code, time_taken
| sort by time_taken
| limit 100

panels.name: Outlier - Average Latency Time by Edge Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| timeslice 1h
| avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by _timeslice, edgeloc

panels.name: Average Latency Time in Seconds  by Region
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| if ( edgeloc matches "*IAD*" or edgeloc matches "*DFW*" or edgeloc matches "*JAX*" or edgeloc matches "*LAX*" or edgeloc matches "*MIA*" or edgeloc matches "*JFK*" or edgeloc matches "*EWR*" or edgeloc matches "*SFO*" or edgeloc matches "*SEA*" or edgeloc matches "*IND*" or edgeloc matches "*STL*" or edgeloc matches "*ATL*" or edgeloc matches "*ORD*", "USA", "") as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*AMS*" or edgeloc matches "*DUB*" or edgeloc matches "*FRA*" or edgeloc matches "*LHR*" or edgeloc matches "*MXP*" or edgeloc matches "*CDG*" or edgeloc matches "*ARN*" or  edgeloc matches "*MUC*", "EUROPE", region) as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*HGK*" or edgeloc matches "*NRT*" or edgeloc matches "*SIN*", "Asia", region) as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*GRU*", "South America", region) as region
| if (region == "","Other",region) as region 
| avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by region

panels.name: Visitor Access Platforms
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront 
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| urldecode(user_agent) as agent
| if (agent matches "*iPad*" OR agent matches "*iPhone*" OR agent matches "*BlackBerry*" OR agent matches "*Galaxy*" OR agent matches "LGE-*" OR agent matches "SCH-*" OR agent matches "*HUAWEI-*" OR agent matches "*SAMSUNG*" OR agent matches "*samsung*" OR agent matches "Dalvik/*" OR agent matches "Nokia*" OR agent matches "LG-*" OR agent matches "*CFNetwork*"  OR agent matches "*UP.Browser/*" OR agent matches "*QQ*rowser*" OR agent matches "*NetFront/*" OR agent matches "*Windows Phone*" OR agent matches "*iemobile*","mobile","") as type
| if (agent matches "*Windows NT*" OR agent matches "*i686*" OR agent matches "*x86*","PC",type) as type
| if (agent matches "*Macintosh*","Mac",type) as type
| if (type = "","unknown",type) as type
| count type

panels.name: Visitor Session Duration Distribution Histogram
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| _messagetime as mt 
| min(mt) as start, max(mt) as stop by c_ip
| (stop - start)/60000 as durationInMin
| (ceil(durationInMin/5))*5 as bucketSize
| count by c_ip,bucketSize | count by bucketSize | sort by +bucketSize

panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice 5m 
| count_distinct(c_ip) as UniqueVisitors by _timeslice, _sourcecategory
| transpose row _timeslice column _sourcecategory

panels.name: Visitor Browsers and Devices
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| urldecode(user_agent) as agent
| if (agent matches "*Windows NT*","Windows","") as OS |
if (agent matches "*Macintosh*","MacOS","") as OS |
if (agent matches "*iPad*","iPad","") as OS |
if (agent matches "*iPhone*","iPhone","") as OS |
if (agent matches "*Android*","Android","") as OS |
if (OS == "","Other","") as OS |
if (agent matches "*MSIE*","Internet Explorer","") as Browser |
if (agent matches "*Firefox*","Firefox","") as Browser |
if (agent matches "*Safari*","Safari","") as Browser | 
if (agent matches "*Chrome*","Chrome","") as Browser |
if (Browser == "","Other","") as Browser | 
count(agent) by OS,Browser 
| transpose row os column browser as *

panels.name: Client and Server Errors Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront | parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice by 5m | where status matches "4*" or status matches "5*"
| if(status matches "5*", "server_error", if(status matches "4*", "client_error", "other_error")) as type 
| timeslice by 5m |  count by type, _timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column type

panels.name: HTTP Response Classes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront 
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status_code,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| if(status_code matches "2*", 1, 0) as successes | if(status_code matches "3*", 1, 0) as redirects | if(status_code matches "4*", 1, 0) as client_errors | if(status_code matches "5*", 1, 0) as server_errors | timeslice by 5m | sum(successes) as successes, sum(client_errors) as client_errors,  sum(redirects) as redirects, sum(server_errors) as server_errors by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(5m) 
| sort by _timeslice asc

panels.name: Traffic and Megabytes Served
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudFront 
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice by 1h
| count as hits, sum(scbytes) as sum_bytes_served by _timeslice
| sum_bytes_served/(1048576) as mb_served | round(mb_served)
| fields - sum_bytes_served
